caption: The drawing features two main objects: a stylized flower and a jar. In the upper section, there is a simple line drawing of a jar in blue ink, with a depiction of a three-flowered branch bearing elongated petals and leaves inside its outline, also drawn in blue lines. Below this, occupying a larger central area, there is a more detailed painting of the same three-flowered branch with elongated leaves. The painting utilizes shades of blue for the flowers, leaves, and stems, and black dots for the flower centers, all rendered with loose brushstrokes. The background of the lower painted section consists of a light beige wash. The entire composition is set against an off-white or light beige paper, and the artist's name, Yolande Delasser, is written in small text at the bottom right of the painted section.
title: Jar
